test_group_by_basic: test SQL GROUP BY with aggregate functions, HAVING clause, and ORDER BY on a scan_ipc LazyFrame
test_group_by_all: test SQL GROUP BY ALL and ORDER BY ALL to group and sort by all non-aggregated columns
test_group_by_all_multi: test GROUP BY ALL, GROUP BY ordinal positions, and GROUP BY column names produce equivalent results
test_group_by_ordinal_position: test SQL GROUP BY using numeric ordinal positions to reference selected columns
